metadata.title: PowerShellGet
metadata.description: PowerShellGet is a compatibility module that allows use of PowerShellGet 2.x (and below) cmdlet syntax with PSResourceGet functionality by making a best effort mapping between the cmdlet interfaces of both versions of the module.

findings.title: Dynamic PowerShell code execution
findings.description: Dynamic evaluation can make a script harder to inspect and may enable downloaded or constructed code to run.
